segments.source: No model can simultaneously satisfy locality, realism, measurement independence, and empirical adequacy for the observed Bell-inequality violations.
No model can simultaneously satisfy noncontextual value definiteness, functional consistency across compatible measurements, and empirical adequacy for the Kochen-Specker configurations.
No model can simultaneously satisfy preparation independence, overlapping psi-epistemic ontic distributions for distinct pure states, and empirical adequacy for the PBR measurement statistics.

No position can simultaneously hold universal validity of quantum theory, single-world outcomes, consistency between agents' conclusions, and the self-referential multi-agent protocol assumptions used by Frauchiger-Renner.
No model can simultaneously satisfy macrorealism per se, non-invasive measurability, induction, and empirical adequacy for a Leggett-Garg inequality violation.

No position can simultaneously hold observer-independent facts, freedom of choice, locality, universal validity of quantum theory, and empirical adequacy for the extended Wigner's-friend correlations in Brukner's theorem.
